runtime_results.scope: One flat analytical DDM teaching workflow on Python 3.12.13/macOS arm64; uv-installed HSSM 0.5.0, Bambi 0.19.0, PyMC 6.1.0, ArviZ 1.2.0 and NumPy 2.4.6 with system Graphviz.
checks: deterministic adapter and installed CLI contracts
domain summaries, execution gates and report failure handling
independent numerical prior and joint-likelihood verification
full notebook export and saved-artifact checks
shared assessment/plot consistency and actual legacy/modern reporting harnesses; strict cross-environment common-method comparison
limitations: The conda environment recipe itself was not executed.
Corrected RT calibration is fair: the coverage-transformed PIT test rejects uniformity (p=3.1641e-15); ordinary RT PIT and both choice tests pass. The flag remains in the report.
Native density recomputation is guarded to require default sample coordinates; historical dependency failures are archived, and the notebook guard remains tested.
One teaching dataset does not establish parameter recovery or joint, conditional or held-out calibration.
Posterior-predictive draws have no public HSSM random-seed argument.
ArviZ-stats 1.2 can raise for sufficiently uniform LOO-PIT values; errors are propagated, and scalar HSSM views use PPC-PIT only.

historical_tests.scope: 139 HSSM checks plus 32 shared calibration regressions at the recorded development revision; not the current maintained suite

runtime_results.maintained_test_scope: Adapter/CLI, notebook domain calculations and gates, report correctness/failure handling, and compact example prior/support and joint-likelihood checks. Broader dependency and saved-export audits are archived on the development fork.

reason: Runtime validation remains separate from agent performance. The authorized reduced handoff baseline hit its native token-budget guard before finishing; treatment was not started. No completed paired or trigger scores or improvement claims are available.
